_doc: Fighter jet tuning, loaded over config/flight.json for courses whose vehicle is "jet" (see courses/index.json); a key left out keeps the flight.json value. TOUCH_MODE "rate": the stick sets roll and pitch rates and letting go holds the attitude, so loops and rolls work and nothing caps bank or climb. "attitude" gives the stunt plane's bank/climb stick instead. CAM_ROLL 1 keeps the camera rolled with the jet (needed for loops).
